ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light gray) covering approximately 85% of the surface area, contrasted with low-intensity (black/dark gray) regions at the distal tips and along the entire trailing edge perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light-intensity region across central and mid-lobes. Narrow dark-intensity band along the trailing edge perimeter. Concentrated cluster of dark circular spots (rosettes) surrounding the median notch and extending into the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full trailing edge with larger jagged peaks visible on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a broad, slightly concave arc from notch to tips; distal tips exhibit a sharp upward curvature relative to the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast dark circular clusters (rosettes) located primarily in the central region adjacent to the notch and scattered across lower-middle lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant concentration of circular barnacle scars (rosettes) surrounding the base of the fluke near the peduncle connection.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized occlusion and specular highlights caused by water spray and droplet streaks falling from the right distal tip and trailing edge.
